summary.en: Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica, the 14-character Brazilian company registration number. Alphanumeric since July 2026, with two numeric mod-11 check digits.
summary.pt-BR: Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica, o número de 14 caracteres que identifica empresas e entidades. Alfanumérico desde julho de 2026, com dois dígitos verificadores numéricos por módulo 11.

format.summary: Formats a given CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) value according to the specified options.
description: - `options.pad` left-pads the value with zeros to 14 characters first.
- `options.version`: `1` (default) keeps digits only; `2` (alphanumeric CNPJ) keeps letters, upper-cased, and digits.
- `options.obfuscate` hides the first 2 digits and the 2 check digits with `*`, after padding.
- Pending decision (findings §2 #2, #3): the reference (JS) masks an incomplete value as far as it goes and returns an empty string for empty or garbage input; other libs return null.

generate.summary: Generates a valid random CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica).
description: Generates a valid random CNPJ, unformatted.

- `versionOrParams` picks the version, `1` (default, numeric) or `2` (alphanumeric), and optionally the branch (número de ordem), an integer from 1 to 9999 (random by default; an invalid branch is ignored).
- The branch block stays numeric in both versions.

tests.name: generated-is-valid
tests.note: every generated value must pass the lib's own validator

isValid.summary: Validates if a CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) is valid. Supports both numeric (version 1) and alphanumeric (version 2) CNPJ formats. Accepts the usual mask characters (`.`, `-`, `/`) and whitespace around and between groups.
description: Validates a CNPJ: 12 base characters and 2 modulus 11 check digits.
- `options.version`: `1` (default) accepts numeric CNPJs only; `2` also accepts the alphanumeric CNPJ, case-insensitively. Any other value is read as `1`.
- A numeric CNPJ whose digits are all the same is rejected; the alphanumeric format has no reserved list.
- Pending decision (findings §2 #1): the reference (JS) ignores the mask characters (`.`, `-`, `/`) and whitespace around and between groups; other libs accept digits only.

parse.summary: Removes CNPJ formatting characters and returns a normalized value.
description: Removes CNPJ formatting and returns the normalized value, capped to 14 characters.
- `options.version`: `1` (default) keeps digits only; `2` keeps letters and digits, upper-cased.
